description: This file defines the OutcomeByMonthDashlet class, a dashboard chart component for SuiteCRM that visualizes opportunities data over months, including chart rendering and query construction.

classes.name: OutcomeByMonthDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard chart class for visualizing opportunity outcomes by month in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with default or provided date range options.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays options for the dashlet, including user selection.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML/JavaScript for rendering the chart.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to fetch opportunity data grouped by month and sales stage.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares and formats the data for chart rendering, including labels, tooltips, and series.
